test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All mobiles are laptops.

II. All laptops are notebooks.

III. All notebooks are books.

**Conclusions:**

I. All books are laptops.

II. Some notebooks are mobiles.

III. All laptops are books.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de3524951b53b28e0e96f3df1de88b4527408ff988830af4f833f6d20c6d0f9b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All books are laptops → Does not follow (As all laptops are notebooks and all notebooks are books. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some notebooks are mobiles → **F**ollow (As all mobiles are laptops and all laptops are notebooks. As whole mobiles comes in laptops which whole comes in notebooks, therefore it is true.)

III. All laptops are books → Follow (As all laptops are notebooks and all notebooks are books. As whole laptops comes in notebooks which whole comes in books, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Conclusions II and III follow.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
